parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse('/work/output/artifacts/skill-bpmn-edit-move-node/Onboarding.bpmn')
root = tree.getroot()
ns = {'bpmn':'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL','bpmndi':'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI','uipath':'http://uipath.org/schema/bpmn'}
proc = root.find('bpmn:process', ns)

# Sequence flows
flows = {sf.get('id'): (sf.get('sourceRef'), sf.get('targetRef')) for sf in proc.findall('bpmn:sequenceFlow', ns)}
print('Sequence flows:')
for fid,(src,tgt) in flows.items():
    print(f'  {fid}: {src} -> {tgt}')

# Incoming/outgoing per task
print()
for task in proc.findall('bpmn:scriptTask', ns):
    inc = [e.text for e in task.findall('bpmn:incoming', ns)]
    out = [e.text for e in task.findall('bpmn:outgoing', ns)]
    print(f'  {task.get(\"id\")} ({task.get(\"name\")}): incoming={inc} outgoing={out}')

# Start/End
start = proc.find('bpmn:startEvent', ns)
end = proc.find('bpmn:endEvent', ns)
print(f'  Start outgoing: {[e.text for e in start.findall(\"bpmn:outgoing\",ns)]}')
print(f'  End   incoming: {[e.text for e in end.findall(\"bpmn:incoming\",ns)]}')

# Diagram shapes
print()
diag = root.find('bpmndi:BPMNDiagram/bpmndi:BPMNPlane', ns)
for shape in diag.findall('bpmndi:BPMNShape', ns):
    b = shape.find('{http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC}Bounds')
    print(f'  Shape {shape.get(\"bpmnElement\")}: x={b.get(\"x\")}')

print()
print('XML parses OK')
"

python3 -c "
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse('/work/output/artifacts/skill-bpmn-edit-move-node/Onboarding.bpmn')
root = tree.getroot()
ns = {'bpmn':'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL','bpmndi':'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI','uipath':'http://uipath.org/schema/bpmn'}
proc = root.find('bpmn:process', ns)

# Sequence flows
flows = {sf.get('id'): (sf.get('sourceRef'), sf.get('targetRef')) for sf in proc.findall('bpmn:sequenceFlow', ns)}
print('Sequence flows:')
for fid,(src,tgt) in flows.items():
    print(f'  {fid}: {src} -> {tgt}')

# Incoming/outgoing per task
print()
for task in proc.findall('bpmn:scriptTask', ns):
    inc = [e.text for e in task.findall('bpmn:incoming', ns)]
    out = [e.text for e in task.findall('bpmn:outgoing', ns)]
    print(f'  {task.get(\"id\")} ({task.get(\"name\")}): incoming={inc} outgoing={out}')

# Start/End
start = proc.find('bpmn:startEvent', ns)
end = proc.find('bpmn:endEvent', ns)
print(f'  Start outgoing: {[e.text for e in start.findall(\"bpmn:outgoing\",ns)]}')
print(f'  End   incoming: {[e.text for e in end.findall(\"bpmn:incoming\",ns)]}')

# Diagram shapes
print()
diag = root.find('bpmndi:BPMNDiagram/bpmndi:BPMNPlane', ns)
for shape in diag.findall('bpmndi:BPMNShape', ns):
    b = shape.find('{http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC}Bounds')
    print(f'  Shape {shape.get(\"bpmnElement\")}: x={b.get(\"x\")}')

print()
print('XML parses OK')
"
